Mormon Lake Lodge Out-and-Back

Flagstaff, AZ · Mormon Lake (south of Flagstaff) · Road

Mormon Lake Lodge Out-and-Back is a road group ride in Flagstaff, AZ. It rolls every Thursday at 9:00 am from Lake Mary Rd & Forest Service Road 132 (Mormon Lake Lodge).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Mormon Lake Lodge Out-and-Back group ride

A Thursday road ride on Lake Mary Road in the pines about 25 miles southeast of Flagstaff. Out and back from the lodge. Posted on the Verde Valley club's Meetup, where riders from Flagstaff and the valley meet up.
